title: Archive-first: localize replication variance before recovery hand-back
hypothesis: The weak Q1 lineage loses recovery opportunities before rolling restarts, rather than losing established rolling when support ends.

prediction.rationale: Compare lineage 2 with the equal-weight mean of the other four Stage-B lineages: the all-case fraction that triggers recovery while retained but never achieves a Stage-3 rolling step before boost ends should be at least 0.05 higher. D-093 examined already re-captured episodes, excluding this mechanism; D-090 examined historical JOINT, not replication variance. This is descriptive localization, not causal attribution.

protocol.command: gpu run bash -lc 'source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --protocol q1-recovery-entry-audit --archive-protocol R-128 --weak-lineage 2 --reference config/pen_spin/r121_joint_finalist/finalist.json --output logs/pen_spin/q1_recovery_entry_audit --max-wall-minutes 15'
code_changes: scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: add the archive-only protocol selector, reconstruct trigger-to-boost-end events using existing trace logic, and report case-clustered intervals across all five lineages; do not launch simulations or reopen the refuted release hypothesis.

falsified_by: The upper 95% bound on the specified lineage difference is below 0.05; an interval spanning 0.05 is inconclusive. Failure to reconstruct the event from existing traces also makes the audit inconclusive, without authorizing new rollouts.
direction: Continue Stage-3 Shadow Hand axial-rolling research from the frozen R-121 JOINT controller. Prioritize independent training reproducibility, then robustness of frozen controllers. Reproduce the successful residual-plus-recovery construction across independent training seeds before claiming a reliable learning algorithm. Evaluate longer horizons and predeclared physical/reset perturbations without fitting. Use archived failures to decide whether recovery hand-back deserves a state-dependent transition study. Then investigate whether LLM-guided construction can discover useful recovery-module structure against grammar search and the hand-designed template under matched budgets. Preserve the original six-second task and evaluation contract. Use JOINT as the experimental reference, preserve all existing assets, and leave default-incumbent installation separate. Run one protocol at a time through the existing advisor/implementer loop. Continue justified follow-ups within this direction; honor its escalation and exhaustion rules. No new global budget ceiling is imposed; each protocol must declare finite simulator, wall-time and model-call costs before agreement. No controller-generation calls for Q1–Q3. Q4 requires a separately agreed generation budget. Advisor calls for the research loop remain permitted throughout.

advisor.reasoning: This prioritizes training reproducibility and tests a cohort excluded by D-093: gate_statistics should increase by at least 0.05 for lineage 2 versus the equal-weight mean of R-128's other four Stage-B lineages. The post-selected weak lineage limits interpretation to descriptive localization, but the archive-only cost is appropriate: 0 episodes, 0 model calls and 15 minutes. falsified_by: the upper 95% bound is below +0.05; unavailable events or a threshold-spanning interval are inconclusive and authorize no new rollouts.

implementer.reasoning: This is a second post-hoc story about one post-selected lineage. D-093 already looked at lineage 2's stage-B cells and found nothing distinctive there (its stage-B module resembles the others; its release change is slightly below theirs). A new statistic on the same n = 1 lineage, chosen after the first one failed, cannot localize 'replication variance': whatever it shows describes one ARS trajectory, has no stated consequence for any next step, and five lineages give no way to tell a mechanism from an idiosyncrasy. The direction's rule is not to invent repeated diagnostics; zero episodes does not make it informative. The reproducibility question D-088 left open is the between-lineage spread, and only more lineages (a new, costly idea the user should choose) would narrow it.

advisor.reasoning: This examines a pre-rolling failure cohort excluded by D-093, but provides no decision that its descriptive result would change. I accept the implementer's repeated-post-selection and missing-decision objections; 0 episodes, 0 LLM calls and 15 minutes do not make another diagnostic informative about training reproducibility. The registered gate_statistics increase of at least 0.05 for lineage 2 versus the equal-weight mean of R-128's other four Stage-B lineages is falsified_by an upper 95% bound below +0.05; a threshold-spanning interval or unavailable trace reconstruction is inconclusive. Reconsider only with a prospectively specified, decision-linked contrast across independent training lineages rather than another statistic selected around lineage 2.

implementer.reasoning: Unchanged from round 1: no decision depends on the result and the direction asks not to invent further diagnostics or confirmations.
